patch_description: Replace the naive concentric-ring layout with a hexagonal grid layout (rows of 5,6,5,6,4 circles = 26), which is the natural near-optimal structure for packing circles of similar size, exploiting the hexagonal packing density locally. Then improve radius computation in two ways: (1) iterate the pairwise scaling passes until convergence instead of a single pass (a single pass under-scales radii badly since each pair adjustment invalidates earlier ones), and (2) add a gentle center-relaxation phase that pushes overlapping circle pairs apart while respecting the square boundary, letting the grid relax into the walls and fill corner gaps. This yields much larger radii while keeping the construction explicit and fully valid.
